programme.title: UpRooted With Sarah Sharratt
programme.desc: Host Sarah Sharratt visits the artisanal food producers of French Basque country. She helps herd the pigs and sheep that roam the rolling Pyrenees mountains. Inspired by her trip, Sarah throws a 'tapas' or small plates party for her friends using some of the delicious Basque ham, famous piment d'Espelette spice and other fresh food sourced from this special region.

programme.title: Jamie's Quick & Easy Food
programme.desc: Jamie’s cooking up his mouthwatering Mustardy Beef with phenomenal flavor from just five ingredients. Next, there’s his foolproof baked saffron rice that will revolutionize the way you cook this glorious grain.

programme.title: UpRooted With Sarah Sharratt
programme.desc: It's truffle season and everyone in the Périgord Noir region of France has gone truffle crazy. Host Sarah Sharratt is excited to get her hands on one of these much prized fungi to see what the fuss is all about. Sarah prepares a truffle packed dinner featuring truffled brie, champagne risotto with black truffles, barbecued beef with a traditional truffle sauce and chocolate truffles.
